components.css: .ds-sky { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(31, 1fr); gap: 3px; align-items: end; height: 112px; } .ds-sky-day { display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; gap: 1px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; border-radius: 3px; transform-origin: bottom; animation: ds-lift 640ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; transition: scale 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-sky-day:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-sky-day:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sky-day i { min-height: 2px; border-radius: 2.5px; } .ds-sky-today { outline: 1.5px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sky-empty { height: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--line2); } .ds-sky-future { justify-self: center; width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--line2); } .ds-sky-axis { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink3); } .ds-legend { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 14px; margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink2); } .ds-legend span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-legend i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-legend b { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink3); } @keyframes ds-lift { from { scale: 1 0; } }

components.css: .ds-head { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); } .ds-head-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--ink2); } .ds-head-row h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-step { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: none; color: inherit; transition: scale 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-step:hover { background: var(--surface2); } .ds-step:active:not(:disabled) { scale: 0.97; } .ds-step:disabled { opacity: 0.3; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-filter { margin-left: auto; } .ds-filter b { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; position: absolute; top: -4px; right: -4px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bg); } .ds-total { margin: 16px 0 0; font-size: 60px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-total small { font-size: 0.5em; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.65; } .ds-vs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 10px 0 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink2); } .ds-delta { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--up); } .ds-head-row h1 { font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-total { font-family: Libre Caslon Text, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; }

components.css: .ds-dock { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--glass-line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--glass); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.8); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.8); box-shadow: var(--dock); } .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 4px 4px 4px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--bar-active); } .ds-bar-text { flex: 1; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink); } .ds-tok-amt { border-radius: 4px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); } .ds-tok-tag { border-radius: 4px; background: var(--track); color: var(--ink2); } .ds-bar-go { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); transition: scale 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bar-go:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-bar-go:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; height: 52px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink3); text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab[aria-current] { color: var(--ink); } .ds-tab[aria-current] svg { color: var(--accent); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--glass-line); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--glass); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.8); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.8); box-shadow: var(--dock); color: var(--ink); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; transition: scale 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-chip:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile-sm { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) var(--tile-mix, 16%), var(--surface)); }

components.css: .ds-panel { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); } .ds-panel h2 { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px 2px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink2); } .ds-panel h2 span { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink3); } .ds-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; height: 62px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; transition: scale 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--surface2); } .ds-row:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row:not(:last-child)::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 64px; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--line); } .ds-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) var(--tile-mix, 16%), var(--surface)); } .ds-text { display: flex; flex: 1; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; } .ds-text b { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-text small, .ds-amt small { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink3); } .ds-amt { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-panel h2 { font-family: Cinzel, Georgia, serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.css: .ds-seg { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; display: flex; height: 40px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--track); } .ds-seg button { flex: 1; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: none; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--ink2); transition: scale 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-seg .ds-seg-on { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--thumb); } .ds-seg button:active { scale: 0.97; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Banknote engraving for a phone-first expense tracker: green paper in light mode, forest surfaces in dark, Cinzel Roman capitals for headings and Libre Caslon Text for the main total. Source Sans 3 keeps notes, controls and tabular amounts readable. A faint static guilloche sits behind Home and Stats totals. Keep the one-line entry bar, skyline and existing interactions. Avoid grain, double frames and dotted coin rims.
keyCharacteristics: A 60px total in ink on the ground at the top of Home and Stats; no coloured field.
The Day skyline under the Home total: one stacked column per day.
Grouped panels on a green paper ground; inset hairlines inside a panel, none between panels.
Category emoji in tinted tiles; category colour in tiles, the skyline, its legend, share tracks and nowhere else.
Cinzel headings, Libre Caslon Text totals, Source Sans 3 words and tabular figures.
One frosted dock: bar and tabs as one surface.
Motion with a job: rise, press, count-up, lift, grow-in, draw.

rules.name: The Ground Rule
rules.body: The headline figure sits on the ground, in ink. No coloured field or card behind it.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: Banknote green marks what is live or what commits, plus this period's line on Stats. Never category data, never headings, never a background.

rules.name: The Category Colour Rule
rules.body: Category colour appears as a tinted tile behind the emoji, as skyline segments and legend squares on Home, and as share-track fills on Stats. Never as text colour, never as a button.

rules.name: The Twin Token Rule
rules.body: Components use tokens, never raw hex. A category's own colour reaches CSS through the `--c` custom property on `.tile` or an inline `background`.

rules.name: Roman headings
rules.body: Cinzel capitals for headings only. Controls, notes and prose stay in sentence case.

rules.name: Tabular everywhere
rules.body: Use lining tabular figures on body text and the num utility.

dos: **Do** open Home and Stats on the ground with the 60px numeral in Ink; let context follow it.
**Do** tell the Home month as the Day skyline: one column per day, stacked in category colour, tappable to its day.
**Do** set every non-hero amount, delta, share and axis label in Source Sans 3 (`num`).
**Do** give every category row a tinted tile; use the eight-hue palette for defaults and swatches.
**Do** group rows in Level 1 panels with inset hairlines.
**Do** draw the cumulative spend line with the previous period as a ghost, and a today marker while the period runs.
**Do** hide a day's total when the day has one row.
**Do** show "new" once, as one line under the category panel.
**Do** keep the bar, its parsing, ghost, chips, receipt and undo exactly as they behave now.
**Do** reference tokens, never raw hex, so the dark twin follows.
donts: **Don't** add donuts or pies. Bars, lines, tracks and the skyline are the chart vocabulary.
**Don't** add a floating action button or a multi-field form as the way in.
**Don't** put the headline figure on a coloured field or card, or fill the delta as a pill.
**Don't** use Banknote green for decoration or as a background behind content.
**Don't** colour text, buttons or backgrounds with category colours beyond tiles, the skyline and its legend, and tracks.
**Don't** put an eyebrow label above a heading or the numeral, or uppercase controls and body copy.
**Don't** use Unicode glyphs as icons (arrows, hashes, chevrons); draw them. Emoji are category content, not icons.
**Don't** use gradient text, glass anywhere but the dock and chips, or zero-offset glows.
**Don't** animate without a job, or skip the reduced-motion guard.
